structured.question: Explain the psychological basis of emotions. (10 marks)
markingGuide: Theories e.g. James-Lange and Cannon-Bard: 4 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Emotions include subjective, physiological and behavioural components explained by major theories.

structured.question: Describe emotional responses seen in people due to disease or illness. (10 marks)
markingGuide: Five responses such as denial, anger, anxiety: 10 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Denial, anger, bargaining, anxiety, depression and acceptance may occur.

structured.question: Explain five methods of reading skills. (10 marks)
markingGuide: Five methods such as skimming and scanning: 10 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Skimming, scanning, intensive, critical and SQ3R reading.

structured.question: Explain the different barriers to learning. (10 marks)
markingGuide: Barriers such as physical, emotional and environmental: 10 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Physical, psychological, social and instructional barriers.

structured.question: Describe the SQ3R strategy for effective reading. (10 marks)
markingGuide: Survey, Question, Read, Recite, Review: 10 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Survey, question, read, recite and review.
